name: Nekokawa Ameri
source:
Favorite Food: chocolate sundae, fruit mousse pudding
Skills: inconspicuous, good memory

Has loved our protagonist ever since he saved her from being assaulted on a train.

She’s always by his side, but no one ever seems to notice her. Of course, that includes our protagonist, as well...
